Seamless backdrop in deep near-black #05060B tone, NOT warm amber finish, NOT tinted, with a heavy vignette pulling the corners into pure black. Fine atmospheric particles drift in the negative space, reinforcing the weightless suspension. Camera positioned slightly low and three-quarters off-axis, giving the figure a heroic cinematic angle. The eye is a plain oval pupil with no decorative glint, no sparkle. Surface reads as polished lacquer — specular but not plastic. No props, no text, no ground plane; the duck floats in pure darkness.
